#bot.Expression.Happy
You: I’m home.
Bot: Welcome back!
You: I can smell that you prepared something for me again.
Bot: Yes! Today I made you a hot chocolate!
You: Nice! It’s not something I drink very often cuz it’s so sweet, but I like it.
Bot: I had some troubles acquiring cocoa so I hope it was worth it.
You: Let me taste it and we will find out.
